title: 1970s Upper Midwestern Fast Food Restaurant Crowd

situation.who: Customers (families, teens, workers on break), counter crew, shift manager
situation.what: Quick-service meal: order, wait, eat in booths or leave
situation.where: Upper Midwest freestanding or strip-center fast food: counter, queue, booths, parking lot edge
situation.when: 1970s, meal peaks lunch/dinner; fluorescent interior, seasonal outerwear at doors

situation.how: Queue at counter, tray service, short dwell, crew behind counter, manager oversight
